title: Implement complete checkpoints and review submission evidence

checkpoint.summary: Implemented and verified immutable Working progress checkpoints, atomic submission/replacement final checkpoints with pinned spec/source/ref and separate owner-reported test evidence, plus immutable reviewer decision evidence for the frozen revision distinguishing inspection, reported tests and acceptance. Exposed six opt-in MCP methods, 64-bit checkpoint lookup, and safe reconciliation of old pending review commands without fabricating evidence. Full client suite 333/333 and server 62/62 passed. V2-08 now independently pins approved source repository fetch/push endpoints (instead of the ledger project UUID), revalidates source identity at review/integration, and preserves frozen revision provenance across worktree/branch rename. Verified with full 336 client / 62 server tests and adversarial disposable Git fixtures. V2-05 acceptance is complete.
checkpoint.nextAction: V2-05 completed following V2-08 independent provenance verification. Next dependent task: V2-06 frozen reviewer claims and orphan-ref recovery. No live V2 initialization, deployment, push or V1 migration.
